method: Whole pinned module read; three exact original dependency-free test functions and their unchanged implementations extracted and run with rustc --test.
findings: Original HTML text extraction, preset matching and provider-id tests passed:3/3. No completion request or URL fetch executed; passing presets does not prove provider API compatibility.

Pooled database connection falls back to in-memory on file-open failure and rebuilds only when APPDATA-derived path changes. A transient failure at a fixed path can retain fallback rather than retry disk opening. No filesystem-failure runtime fixture in this batch.

Key-optional determination uses only database endpoint before later environment/file endpoint resolution. An optional local provider supplied solely through endpoint environment/file can still fail missing-key validation. Source-level configuration-flow finding; no real environment credentials read.

Configuration reads separate settings under separate locks, so endpoint/model/key are not obtained as one atomic settings snapshot. Provider-agnostic environment-key precedence is independent of endpoint selection. No misrouted request observed.

Each completion attempt uses60second request timeout; embedded-key retry count can multiply total duration. No cancellation token in this module. Multi-turn API accepts exactly one previous user/assistant pair; no full-history persistence implemented here.

Anthropic format selects first system message and first content block; other format selects first choice content string. This qualifies implemented response shape only, not every provider response. Endpoint classification is a case-sensitive substring test rather than parsed host equality.

HTML summarization truncates extracted text to12000UTF8-boundary bytes after fetching and conversion. No explicit body byte cap before conversion appears in this source; dependency-level limits remain unqualified. html_to_text explicitly documents approximate rather than full HTML parsing.

Original config-resolution test mutates/removes six environment variables but restores only APPDATA. It uses one fixed temporary directory with remove_dir_all; test-local mutex does not isolate other processes. This environment-affecting original test was not run.

This module is an AI client and supplies no content-duplicate algorithm or benchmark. No key files, actual credential values, compile-time keys, user databases, services or network endpoints were accessed by review controls.
